items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Wasn't there a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him? I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson.

ctx.x: A fella by the name of Bill Jackson used to play with them?

Hmm? Bill Jackson used to play with them? Wasn't there a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him? I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson. He played with him. He played with him.

He played with him. He played with him. He played with him. I don't know a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him. I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson. He played Sam.
